title: Acceleration from v-t graph
description: Essential: Correctly calculates the acceleration of rod G during 1-2 s using the slope from the provided graph.

title: Tension on block A
description: Essential: Correctly applies Newton's second law to block A on the incline to find the string tension during 1-2 s.

title: Power of pulling force
description: Essential: Correctly computes the instantaneous power at t=1.5 s as the product of the pulling force on H and H's velocity.

title: Distance via impulse-momentum
description: Essential: Correctly calculates the distance rod G travels from 2-3 s using the impulse-momentum theorem and Faraday's law.

title: Circuit current analysis
description: Important: Correctly determines the constant circuit current during 1-2 s using Faraday's law, Ohm's law, and the constant velocity difference.

title: Force balance on rod G
description: Important: Applies Newton's second law to rod G, relating tension, Ampere force, and its acceleration during 1-2 s.

title: Velocity relationship use
description: Important: Correctly uses the kinematic relationship v_H = v_G + constant to find H's velocity at t=1.5 s.

title: Unit consistency
description: Optional: Maintains consistent SI units (m, s, kg, A, etc.) throughout all calculations.

title: Sign error in Ampere force
description: Pitfall: Uses the wrong direction for the Ampere force on rod G or H in Newton's second law equations.

title: Misinterpreting v-t graph
description: Pitfall: Misreads the velocity values or time intervals from the provided v-t graph for rod G.
